comment: The partials knob is a power of two, OscS.cpp:143 and OscS.cpp:195, so its ten steps give 1 to 512 partials. The maker recommends the background thread only in a patch that is already using a good deal of processor, because below a buffer size of 256 it takes a whole core for every four voices. The Dist and Seed knobs take effect at the next reset rather than at once.
